file_impact.reason: The fix: a function whose os.environ key expression references one of its OWN parameters is an env-read helper by construction, so an unregistered one now raises UnregisteredEnvReadHelper naming every site instead of being walked past. Registers the three unregistered shims found by census.
Generated artifact, regenerated in the same change: 162 -> 164 keys (REBAR_GATE_REF, REBAR_GATE_SOURCE recovered) plus the header prose that now states the helper half is fail-closed.

Registering read_secret_env made a real JIRA_API_TOKEN credential read visible to check_config_ownership.py, which imports KNOWN_ENV_HELPERS. The read is correctly placed (bool() discards the value at the composition root), so it takes a narrow one-line read-via marker rather than a module-wide boundary exemption.

RED oracle: an unregistered parameterized helper aborts the scan naming helper/module/line; plus the false-positive control (inline literal reader), the registered-helper control, and the real-tree assertion for the two measured keys.
b00f replay at runtime: dropping the row for a live helper must fail loudly naming it, not silently shrink the registry by four variables.
